d:
What if the tsundere wasn't just being cute, but had actually, irreversibly ruined your life?

And what if her target wasn't some whiny, Shinji-tier sad sack, but a genuinely bad dude who's finally had enough and is very ready to do something about it?

Find out in this Super Punch-Out!! × Zero no Tsukaima! crossover:

From the author of
Quadruple Amputee Meido vs Roomba-senpai & Alexa-chan,
and the upcoming Fetus Soupetus (coming soon to a 1.5-star-rated gallery near you),

it's....

My Beat-Up Darling!

A love story told entirely through emotional damage and uppercuts.

Step into the ring.
She's violent. He's angrier.
Romance has never hit this hard.
n: [Doujinshi] [Mega Black (Dorozumi)] Tsundere Bouryoku Heroine o Shin no Bouryoku de Wakaraseru! | True violence for tsundere violent heroines!
